conventions.convention: The metric signature is (-,+,+,+), frame indices range from 0 to 3, and e is the dual coframe of a smooth future-directed tetrad on a nonempty open set. Countable Choice is assumed for the inherited smooth tangent-bundle conventions.
Coframes transform by e′=Λe, frames by E′=EΛ⁻¹, and connection matrices by ω′=ΛωΛ⁻¹−dΛΛ⁻¹. Matrix-valued form products retain matrix multiplication order. T=de+ω∧e and F=dω+ω∧ω.
SO⁺(1,3) consists of determinant-one Lorentz matrices preserving C⁺={(t,x):t>|x|}, with the Euclidean matrix subspace topology.
The covering uses the explicitly displayed Pauli matrices, X(x)=x⁰I+Σxⁱσᵢ, and X(ρ(A)x)=AX(x)A†; the Lorentz quadratic form is −det X.

Principal bundles have right actions. Associated bundles identify (ua,v) with (u,σ(a)v); representing functions satisfy f(ua)=σ(a)⁻¹f(u). A global spin structure and horizontal connection lift are supplied extra data, with no existence assertion.

Constant gamma matrices satisfy {γᴵ,γᴶ}=2ηᴵᴶI. Clifford multiplication is c(V)=V_Iγᴵ and Γ=¼ω_IJγᴵγᴶ. The compatibility conclusion is a local matrix identity, without an asserted identification with a supplied group representation or global connection lift.

load_bearing.statement: A Lorentz connection is a smooth metric-compatible affine connection, with η-skew local connection matrix. Under e′=Λe, ω′=ΛωΛ⁻¹−dΛΛ⁻¹; torsion and curvature are T=de+ω∧e and F=dω+ω∧ω.

Assuming Countable Choice, the displayed Hermitian-matrix action defines a smooth surjective Lie-group homomorphism ρ:SL(2,C)→SO⁺(1,3), with kernel exactly {I,−I} and differential at the identity an isomorphism. It is a two-sheeted covering homomorphism.

Assuming Countable Choice, the orientation-preserving and future-cone-preserving linear isometries from (R⁴,η) to the tangent spaces of an oriented time-oriented smooth Lorentzian four-manifold form a smooth right principal SO⁺(1,3)-bundle under precomposition. No global section is asserted.

Under the stated smooth tetrad and η-skew connection hypotheses and Countable Choice, deᴵ+ωᴵ_J∧eᴶ=0 for every I if and only if the induced affine connection is torsion-free. The unique such torsion-free η-skew connection is Levi-Civita. T′=ΛT and F′=ΛFΛ⁻¹.

A Lorentzian spin structure is a smooth right principal SL(2,C)-bundle with a smooth equivariant map to the oriented time-oriented orthonormal frame bundle, over the identity, whose fiber restrictions are surjective two-sheeted coverings. A connection lift is supplied horizontal data mapped to the supplied frame-bundle horizontal distribution.

For the stated smooth local tetrad, Lorentz connection, constant Clifford matrices, vector field V and Cⁿ-valued field ψ, D(c(V)ψ)=c(∇V)ψ+c(V)Dψ, with D=d+¼ω_IJγᴵγᴶ. This is only the stated local matrix identity.
SL(2,C), with its Euclidean topology as a subset of M₂(C)=R⁸, is path-connected.
SO⁺(1,3) is path-connected and equals the connected component of I₄ in O(1,3) for the specified Euclidean matrix subspace topology.

concerns.concern: Proof step 5.1 says to shrink U so U∩(−U)=∅, but retains V from step 4.1 when asserting that every B with ρ(B)∈V has a representative C∈U and that ρ⁻¹(V)=U⊔(−U). After shrinking U, V must also be replaced by ρ(U). This is an immediate neighborhood-bookkeeping gap; the covering claim remains sound.
